coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should not force an 'inconclusive' verdict when other models successfully reviewed the same files - the audit system should distinguish between 'could not analyze' and 'found issues'

For VCS packages with standard patterns (git+https source, SKIP checksums, cargo/rust build), models should explicitly note this is expected behavior rather than just saying 'no issues found' to reduce ambiguity
When one model has a tool error and another successfully reviews all files with consistent findings, the successful review should carry the verdict weight
